_about: Runtime config of the d20 checks (src/core/checks/d20_config.gd). Source: design/gdd/d20-checks.md, formula 3 (levels, user decision 2026-11-08) and the registry constants chance_window_low/high, profile_gap_min, profile_floor_max. stat_bonus_min/max are frozen product constants in code (D20Config.STAT_BONUS_MIN/MAX), not config. Every key is required: a broken file hides every risky option. tools/validate_data.gd checks formula 3.
